artworks.title: A Funeral Procession
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The horizon is high in the image, showing a townscape with a dome and spires against the sky. A procession is seen on a winding path below. Carriages pulled by horses, people in period attire, some mounted, move along. Onlookers observe on the right. Along the riverbank are large trees with sketched textures. The color palette is soft with muted tones. Buildings and path details are outlined with pen and ink.

artworks.title: The Peep Show
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a large box-like structure with a window and a flag. The scene depicts several individuals closely inspecting or engaging with what appears to be some form of a large play object or mock-up building, complete with a depiction of windows and a mounted blue flag on top. The box-like structure features artistic embellishments, giving it an ornate appearance. Around this object are nine figures, dressed in a variety of eighteenth-century styles, with one figure carrying a large bundle on their back. The setting is in a plain outdoor environment, with soft, muted colors predominating the drawing.

artworks.title: Market Day at Richmond in Yorkshire
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy market scene with people and animals in a town square. Buildings block the horizon, with an obelisk in the square's center and market stalls nearby. A clock tower with a visible clock face is on the left, and beyond are more buildings, including a gothic structure. The brushstrokes are gentle, creating a soft rendering. The color palette consists of muted tones such as pale browns, creams, and soft blue-grays, giving a calm atmosphere. The use of color and detailing enrich the depiction of the marketplace.

artworks.title: The Bridge at Bridgnorth in Shropshire
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a large hill in the background. A bridge arches over a river, with architectural structures visible. The painting features fine, detailed brushstrokes showing textures of stone, water, and foliage. The color palette includes muted earthy tones like browns, grays, and greens. People are seen doing laundry by the riverbank, with a sailboat nearby. In the distance, a hill rises into the sky with clouds.

artworks.title: A Packet Boat off Dover
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with touches of black chalk on gray wove paper, laid down
artworks.description: This painting shows a body of water with a steamboat in the distance emitting gray smoke. The steamboat is only partially visible behind the rough and frothy waves, painted in loose lines of white on the beige paper. The horizon is blurred, with the blue sky blending in with the pale waves. On the left, the silhouettes of buildings are faintly suggested in pale yellow.

artworks.title: A Yorkshire River
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper

artworks.title: Conway in North Wales
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated viewpoint, capturing a small town or village with a downward sloping street. The horizon is high in the composition, revealing a distant landscape beyond. The buildings on the left and right are quaint and rustic, some with thatched roofs, featuring a mix of timber and brickwork. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting architectural elements and textures. The color palette includes earth tones like browns, yellows, and grays, with touches of white and muted blues creating a warm atmosphere. A cobbled street leads towards two carts, figures, and an animal, inviting the viewer into the town scene.

artworks.title: Looking under the Bridge
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from under a large stone archway overlooking a calm waterway. The horizon is near the top of the image with buildings and a tower in the distance. A barge with a dog is moored near the archway, and a rowboat with two people is in the distance. The brushstrokes give the image a soft, slightly textured appearance, with attention to light and shadow on the arch and water. The color palette includes earthy browns and tans for the archway and barge, against soft blues and pinks in the sky. The background shows a hazy silhouette of buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Landing Place near Tintern Abbey
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a high horizon that includes green foliage, hills, and the sky. There is water in the foreground reflecting the surroundings, with a wooden jetty holding two boats, one with a person. Two figures and a horse are walking towards a white cottage with red chimneys and smoke rising. The painting uses smooth brushstrokes and a palette of earthy tones, greens, browns, and soft blues.

artworks.title: Venetian Party in a Chateau Garden
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brown and gray wash, heightened with white on two sheets of paper joined vertically; incised for transfer; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed cityscape from an elevated viewpoint, showcasing intricate architecture and a bustling urban scene. The artwork features fine brushwork with sepia tones, depicting groups of people engaging in activities within the city environment, surrounded by architectural landmarks and natural elements.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Road
artworks.medium: black, yellow, and red chalks with white heightening over gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the image where land and water meet against the backdrop of the sky. The brushstrokes create a sense of impressionism. The color palette includes browns, ochres, and muted greens, giving a tranquil feel. A path winds past trees and rocks in the foreground, with more trees in the distance. Trees of varying sizes are distributed across the view, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: John Beale Bordley
artworks.medium: watercolor on ivory
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Barra Foundation, Inc.
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed miniature portrait of a man in an oval frame. The portrait includes the man's head and top torso. He is facing slightly to the right with a neutral expression, featuring groomed eyebrows and a focused gaze. The man has light skin and dark, wavy hair in a classic historical style. He is dressed in 18th-century attire with a collar and dark outer garment. The gold frame is shiny and smooth, forming an oval shape with a loop for wearing. The background is a neutral light color.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.medium: pen and ink and wash heightened with white on blue prepared paper
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image - two fully clothed figures stand on either side of a seated, partially nude person. The seated figure is in a defensive posture with one arm raised, partially covered with a draped fabric. They have long hair and are facing left. The standing figures grasp the seated person's arms. The figure on the left wears robes and has a bearded face. The figure on the right wears similar attire with a head covering and a beard. Both lean towards the seated individual. In the background on the right is a fountain with intricate designs, including a small statue of an archer on a pedestal. The scene is depicted in monochrome with white highlights on a textured blue surface.

artworks.title: A Young Lady in a Yellow Gown with Blue Ribbons
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper mounted to canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the waist up. She has a serene expression with rosy cheeks and dark, curled hair adorned with a pink rose and blue ribbons. She wears a white gown with lace trim, blue ribbons, and no visible jewelry. The background has muted colors.

artworks.title: De Smaek (Taste)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an outdoor setting. Most are standing, with one person kneeling in front of a table-like structure interacting with someone seated on the ground. The individuals have lined faces, some with beards, and are wearing heavy clothing. They are engaged in different activities, such as touching the table or holding objects. In the background, there are sketched trees and a textured building, suggesting a rural setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruined Monuments
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Ruth Benedict in memory of William S. Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows ancient architectural ruins from an elevated angle, revealing the structures and landscape. The horizon is low, with a tower and greenery fading into the distance. The brushwork features intricate lines creating texture on stone surfaces and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the aged ruins. A stone pillar is prominent on the left, with a hill, trees, and more ruins in the background. An ornate archway is on the right, leading towards distant buildings and a spire. Figures are depicted engaging in different activities, bringing life to the scene.

artworks.title: La paresse (Laziness)
artworks.medium: woodcut on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Frank and Jeannette Eyerly
artworks.description: Created with black ink on cream-white paper, we look down on a nude woman who lies face down on her bed and reaches to pet a cat who stretches up against the bed in this horizontal woodcut. The woman’s knees are bent and her feet dangle in the air, and are cut off by the top edge of the composition. She turns her head to our right as she reaches out with her left hand to pet or scratch the cat’s ears. The woman's forehead, nose, and brows are outlined with a few black lines. Her other elbow is bent with that hand curled in her hair. The bed is draped with fabric covered with geometric patterns, such as checkerboards, zigzags, and diamond shapes. Throw pillows piled under her head and along the far side of her body are decorated with swirls, curves, and dashes. The cat stands on its hind legs with its back to us and its forelegs on the bed. The floor and the area around the bed is black. The words “La Paresse” appear in black letters in a white rectangle at the bottom left of the image and “FV” is inscribed in capitals in the lower right. The artist signed and dated the lower right margin below the image,” fVallotton 32.”

artworks.title: Study for Nude with Hexagonal Quilt
artworks.medium: charcoal and black crayon on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Raymond J. Horowitz

artworks.title: Louis XV, King of France
artworks.artist: Antoine Benoist after Jakob Christoffel Le Blon after Nicholas Blakey
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring the upper body of a man looking slightly to his left. He has European facial features with curly hair styled away from his face. The man is wearing an 18th-century coat with intricate detailing, a cravat, and a sash across his chest. He has a badge or medallion on his coat. The background is an oval frame against a textured wall design, with the name "Louis XV, Roi de France et de Navarre." Below the oval is an ornate crest with fleur-de-lis and a crown.

artworks.title: Eustache Le Sueur
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, positioned partly in front of a round stone frame. The man is seated and faces slightly to the side, looking toward the viewer with a neutral expression. He has curly, medium-length hair and distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and a slight mustache. He is wearing a buttoned vest over a white shirt with a lace collar and puffed sleeves, depicted with detailed cross-hatching. In his right hand, he holds a piece of rolled paper, and nearby lies an artist's palette with brushes. The backdrop consists of a circular stone opening set into a textured stone wall, with text inscribed below.

artworks.title: Jacques Sarazin the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The engraving depicts an upper-body portrait of a man positioned inside an architectural oval frame. The man is seated, with his right arm bent at the elbow and hand resting on the frame. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, and a steady gaze. He wears a buttoned coat with a visible white shirt collar. In front of the frame is a carved bust of a woman's head, along with a quill and inkwell on a pedestal. The background features a textured surface, with inscriptions at the base describing Jacques Sarazin and his professional titles.

artworks.title: I.F.A. Brunet de Neuilly
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.6 x 14.5 cm (7 11/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man within an oval frame. He has distinct facial features and is wearing formal 18th-century attire. The man's hair is styled in tight curls and he has a slightly receding hairline. The engraving style emphasizes texture and shading. Above the frame is a decorative bow, and below the portrait is the inscription "I.F.A. BRUNET DE NEUILLY." The background is textured.

artworks.title: Ph.Cl.A. de Thubieres, Comte de Caylus
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulder portrait of a person in a profile position, facing to the right. The individual's facial features include a prominent nose and chin with a slightly rounded face. Their hair is curly and voluminous, extending to the collar. The person is wearing a high-collared garment with a visible coat. No jewelry or accessories are visible. The background has a textured surface with the portrait framed within a circular medallion adorned at the top with a decorative ribbon. Below the medallion is an inscription identifying the individual as "PH. CL. A. DE THUBIERES, COMTE DE CAYLUS," with a note indicating that the image was drawn by 'cochin' and the engraver, 'le fils,' participated in the work.

artworks.title: Le Marquis Scipion Maffei
artworks.medium: crayon manner etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a side profile portrait of a man's upper body, focusing on his face and shoulders. The man is depicted facing left within a circular frame, adorned with a decorative ribbon at the top. His facial features include a prominent nose, closed lips, and a slightly upward gaze. He has curly hair falling just past his shoulders. The man wears historical attire with layers around his shoulders and neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background inside the circular frame is textured, contrasting with the plain outer background. The text below identifies him as "LE MARQUIS SCIPION MAFFEI" with additional inscriptions.
